description: 한국원자력안전기술원_원자력발전소 사고 고장 DB [electricity and power and nuclear facilities] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국원자력안전기술원. 한국원자력안전기술원(KINS)에서 보유하고 있는 국내 상업용 원자력발전소에서 발생한 보고대상사건에 대한 사고 및 고장 데이터베이스 정보를 오픈포맷으로 제공합니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국원자력안전기술원. Its tags are 원자력발전소, 원전사고, 원전고장, 원전상태, 원자로출력. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-06-27 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
